basics.name: Yang Zhang
basics.label: M.S. Student in Cyberspace Security
basics.summary: I study privacy leakage and defense mechanisms in AI-driven data systems, especially vector databases, RAG pipelines, and encrypted database query systems.

work.summary: Participated in vulnerability reproduction, POC development, and web security testing tasks.
highlights: Reproduced and analyzed high-risk vulnerabilities including Apache bRPC RCE and VMware vCenter Server RCE (CVE-2021-21972).
Built vulnerability reproduction environments and documented trigger conditions, affected versions, exploit paths, and remediation suggestions.
Wrote Python POC scripts and organized automated verification procedures.
Completed web penetration testing tasks involving SQL injection, file upload, file parsing, information leakage, and WAF attack log analysis.

education.institution: Nankai University, College of Cyber Science
courses: Research direction: vector database security, AI security, encrypted database leakage, and RAG security

publications.name: Can I Get More? An Incremental Inference Attack on Encrypted SQL
publications.publisher: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (S&P/Oakland), 2026
publications.summary: An incremental leakage-abuse attack on encrypted SQL systems using anchors, joint distribution leakage, and optimal transport.

publications.name: SLIP Through the Cracks: Semantic Leakage from ID Patterns in Vector Database Similarity Queries
publications.summary: A semantic leakage attack showing that returned ID lists from vector database similarity queries can reveal query labels.

publications.name: You Shouldn't Have Taken It: Detecting Extraction from Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Hidden Representations
publications.summary: A representation-based detector for external data extraction attacks in RAG systems using pre-generation hidden states.

projects.name: Dynamic Searchable Encryption Prototype in openGauss
projects.description: A Fides/Sophos-style dynamic searchable encryption prototype integrated into openGauss query paths.

projects.name: Data Extraction Attack Framework for RAG Systems - DataCon2025
projects.description: A general-purpose RAG extraction attack framework combining instruction injection, BFS exploration, semantic query fusion, and duplicate filtering.

projects.name: SLIP: Vector Database ID-Pattern Leakage Attack
projects.description: A vector database leakage attack showing that returned top-k ID lists can reveal semantic query labels.

projects.name: Encrypted SQL Inference Attack with Anchor-Joint Recovery
projects.description: A plaintext recovery attack against encrypted SQL systems using joint distribution leakage, optimal transport, and anchor-based incremental recovery.
